caption:
Going back for the gloves

Going back for the gloves.

In the cold the body protects its core first and lets the hands cool, so hands are usually the first part to feel it.

For whoever turns around for the gloves.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a closed door on the right. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes says ready! with happy eyes and walks toward the door. It stops and a bubble says gloves? with wide eyes. Then it's fine. Then it shivers with narrowed eyes and a bubble says brr. It turns around and walks back to where it started, and a bubble says gloves! with happy eyes and a pulse. It settles exactly where it started, so the loop is seamless. The text stays: me going back for the gloves.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
